Lena (Auditor): Hi team — for the upcoming ISO/SOC2 review can you provide: 1) RBAC change log for inference service accounts (2025-11-01..2026-02-28) with one-line risk rationale per change; 2) KMS event lines (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/EnableKeyRotation) for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abc-rotation-v2 covering the CVE triage (2026-02-16..2026-02-19); 3) evidence that emergency key rotation completed and that old key material is unusable. Prefer an aggregated CSV plus raw exports and checksums. Confirmable?
Marco - SecEng: Confirm. We'll produce: aggregated CSV (PR, change, one-line rationale, deploy-id, line_index), raw CloudTrail JSONL for RBAC and KMS events, README with redaction rules and checksums. ETA 2 hours for full package, preliminary export in 30m.
Sam Ops: Plan: filter CloudTrail for principals matching svc-infer-* and keyId abc-rotation-v2, correlate UpdateRole/PutRolePolicy events with GitHub PRs via commit hashes and deploy tags. We'll include line indices so auditor can request samples.
Lena (Auditor): Please include who initiated rotation and a short excerpt from the rotation runbook. Also show a short test demonstrating Decrypt behavior before/after rotation (sanitized logs are fine).
Marco - SecEng: Noted. Example per-PR one-liner we'll add: "Scoped PassRole to reduce lateral-assume risk; limited to ecs:task/handler". We'll embed PR -> eventID -> deploy-id mapping in CSV.
